title: Payment
verifiedRetry: Verified. You can submit the payment again.
holdUntil: Pay by {time}. After that, the room is released.
testCards: Demo test cards: {success} (approve), {decline} (decline), {threeDs} (3D Secure). No real payment is taken.
stripeTestMode: Stripe test mode — no real payment is taken.

cancel.confirm: Are you sure you want to cancel the booking?
cancel.noRefund: Cancelled. No refund under the policy.
cancel.failed: The booking could not be cancelled
cancel.dialogBodyHeld: No payment has been taken yet. Cancelling releases the room hold.
cancel.dialogBodyConfirmed: Your refund is calculated from the cancellation policy you accepted when booking and is shown right after cancelling.
cancel.cancelledNoCharge: Cancelled. Your card was not charged.

stepUp.title: Additional verification required
stepUp.description: To protect your account, we ask you to approve this payment with your passkey. After approval the payment is retried automatically.
stepUp.managePasskeys: Create or manage passkeys (opens in a new tab)
stepUp.whatIsPasskey: A passkey is a password-free check that uses the same method you unlock your phone or computer with (fingerprint, face or PIN).
stepUp.noPasskey: If you don't have a passkey, you can create one in a few seconds on your account page, then come back to this window and try again.
stepUp.holdUntil: Your room is held for you until {time}.
stepUp.waitingHint: Approve the passkey prompt your device opened with your fingerprint, face or PIN. If you're verifying with your phone, approve the request on your phone.
stepUp.cancelled: The passkey approval was cancelled or timed out. No payment was taken; you can try again.
stepUp.cancelledNoCharge: You cancelled the extra verification, so no payment was taken. You can retry the payment when you're ready.

rnpl.payLater: Reserve now, pay later: {today} today, {amount} on {date}
rnpl.stepToday: Today: nothing is charged to your card; it is only saved.
rnpl.stepCharge: {date}: {amount} is charged to your saved card.
rnpl.stepFreeCancel: Free cancellation until {date}: cancel before the charge and you pay nothing; cancel after the charge and the full amount is refunded.
rnpl.stepFailure: If the charge fails we notify you and retry; if unpaid within the grace period, the booking is cancelled automatically.

plan.title: Payment plan: reserve now, pay later
plan.summary: {today} paid at booking; {amount} will be charged to your saved card on {date}.
plan.retry: The charge failed; next attempt: {date}. Check your card's balance, limit and expiry date; if you need to use a different card, contact support.
plan.summaryCancelled: The plan was cancelled; your card will not be charged.
plan.summaryDefaulted: The payment could not be collected, so the booking was cancelled; your card will not be charged again.
plan.stepBooked: At booking: {today} paid; your card was only saved.
plan.graceUntil: Payment deadline: {date}. If the charge cannot be collected by then, the booking is cancelled.

rnpl.stepFailureGrace: If the charge fails we notify you and retry; if it is still unpaid after {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}, the booking is cancelled automatically.
rnpl.creditUnavailable: Wallet credit can't be combined with this option; choose to pay now to use your credit.

threeDsIntro: Your bank wants you to approve this payment. Enter the code sent to your phone.
threeDsAnnounce: 3D Secure verification required. Enter the code your bank sent you.
threeDsBack: Go back and use another card
paidAnnounce: Payment received, your booking is confirmed.

hold.warnMinutes: Your room hold ends in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
hold.expired: The hold has expired. The room is no longer reserved for you.
hold.expiredBody: The payment was not completed in time, so the room was released. You have not been charged. You can search the same dates again.

errors.EXPIRY_FORMAT: Enter the expiry date as MM/YY, e.g. 08/28.
errors.CARD_NUMBER_INVALID: The card number is not valid. Please check the number on your card.
errors.CVC_INVALID: The security code (CVC) is not valid. Enter the 3 or 4 digit code on the back of the card.
errors.CARD_EXPIRED: This card has expired. Please try another card.
errors.AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: The verification code was wrong and no payment was taken. Check your card details and try again.
errors.PAYMENT_DECLINED: The payment was declined. Please try another card.
errors.HOLD_EXPIRED: The room hold has expired; no payment was taken.
errors.PAYMENT_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
errors.PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS: A payment for this booking is already being processed. Please wait a few seconds.
errors.PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ERROR: The payment provider cannot be reached right now. You have not been charged; please try again.
errors.INVALID_CARD_TOKEN: Your card details could not be processed. Please enter them again.
errors.FRAUD_BLOCKED: This payment was not approved for security reasons. Try another card or contact support.
errors.NO_PENDING_CHALLENGE: There is no payment waiting for verification. Enter your card details and try again.
errors.IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: You need to verify your identity to continue.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

stripeLiveCharge: When you confirm, {amount} will be charged to your card.

config.failed: The payment form could not be loaded. You have not been charged; please try again.

attempts.left: {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left.
attempts.lockedTitle: Card payment is closed for this booking
attempts.lockedBody: After too many failed attempts, card payment for this booking has been stopped to protect you. You have not been charged. You can contact our support team, or cancel the booking to release the room.

threeDsNoCode: Didn't get a code? Wait a few minutes; if it still doesn't arrive, you can pay with another card below. Your card has not been charged.
stepUpCancelled: Payment not completed; additional verification is needed to continue.
stepUpRetry: You can try again whenever you're ready.
